purpose: Stress-test whether the frozen global sufficiency threshold hides observable subgroup instability without selecting a new threshold.

observable_subgroup_dimensions.question_type: Dataset-provided question_type; missing values become unspecified.
observable_subgroup_dimensions.required_role_count: Number of required evidence roles available to the selector.

stability_rule.global_nominal_bound: Every finite-sample marginal nominal bound must be at or below alpha.
stability_rule.subgroup_mean: Every eligible subgroup mean case-family false-complete rate must be at or below alpha.
stability_rule.repeat_consistency: Every eligible subgroup must have risk at or below alpha in at least 7 repeats.

claim_boundary: Global split-conformal provides a marginal finite-sample statement only under case exchangeability. No distribution-free conditional subgroup guarantee is claimed.
gate_policy: The audit cannot change Gate 2 from NO-GO/SHADOW and cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
